caseName: Interstate Motor Freight System, Inc. v. Messner
caseNameFull: Interstate Motor Freight System, Inc. v. Messner, Secretary of the Department of Revenue and Shirks Motor Express Corp. v. Messner, Secretary of the Department of Revenue
attorneys: Frank A. Sinon for appellants., John R. Norris was also for appellant in No. 615. Frank F. Truscott, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, and Harry F. Stambaugh for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeals are dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

Reported below: 375 Pa. 450, 100 A. 2d 913.
